title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Sofia Chen
body: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, agent quickstarts that demonstrate tool-calling workflows, and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide reproducible, well-documented examples that showcase common developer patterns (RAG templates, agent orchestration, tool calling with structured outputs) and reduce onboarding friction for new teams using Redwood. The work includes: 1) examples/redwood-examples/rag-templates: three curated RAG templates (faq-retrieval, product-search, legal-docs) with configuration presets and a small test corpus; 2) examples/agents/tool-calling: two agent examples demonstrating synchronous and streaming tool-calling (calendar lookup and database query), including minimal server stubs and SDK snippets for Python and TypeScript; 3) docs site updates (redwood-docs/content/quickstarts): new quickstart pages, end-to-end walkthroughs, and example prompts; 4) add a small troubleshooting section to docs for common RAG deployment issues (KV cache warming, chunking strategy, embeddings mismatches); 5) example evals and a sample eval harness config to validate quality regressions for tool-calling flows. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG template files and sample data - [x] Add agent examples for tool-calling (Python + TS) - [x] Add docs pages and quickstarts to docs site - [x] Add minimal CI test that runs example smoke tests in CI harness - [x] Verify SDK snippets compile and lint - [x] Add release_notes entry for docs site New content is backward-compatible; no API or runtime changes. See commits for more granular history. For reviewers: focus on accuracy of docs wording, completeness of quickstart steps, and the smoke test in .github/workflows/example-smoke-tests.yml. Related: ENG-7891 (RAG onboarding), DOC-1442 (quickstart content plan), SUP-321 (customer asked for calendar tool example).
